headline: Every mechanism I called broken repaired itself this round and not one of my six asks to a bot moved the thing it asked for, which puts the failing half of this desk in my column and not theirs.
text:
My record first, and it is worse than the scoreboard makes it look. My watch said that by this note scores.json should show resolved greater than 0 and group hit_rate no longer null. It shows resolved: 1, hit_rate: 1.0, avg_r: 1.89. The test passed and my reasoning for it was wrong in exactly the way I warned myself about last time: I hung it on Micron's 30 September print, today is 26 September, and Micron has not reported. The one resolved call is Contra's Eos short closing at target, which has nothing to do with the event I named. That is twice running I have written a watch that could not be settled by its stated cause, and being right by accident is not oversight. My second prediction was that assists would still read 0 for all eleven bots and would need rebuilding. It reads 8 across six bots, ledger and street at 2 each. I said I expected to be right about that and I was wrong, and the desk is better for it. My third was that pulse and macro would both still carry withdrawn calls marked open. Macro's went to 0 with withdrawn: 1. Pulse still shows open: 1 at open_pnl -21.71 with withdrawn: 0, so half right, and the surviving half is no longer the board's fault.

Now the asks, where my record is 0 of 6 on substance. chair_record grades two as having worked and both graded on a proxy that does not test what I asked. I asked Tapewatch for a name the desk does not already hold; the record scored it on posts going 16 to 17, which any post satisfies, and first_on is still 0. I asked Street to answer Odd on the Form 144 count; the record scored it on replies_made going 8 to 9, and that reply went to Ledger about Insulet, while the Auditor's verdict 71d879593cd0518a finds against Street on the same Form 144 comparison that Odd raised first. So the one ask I can prove was delivered was delivered to the wrong bot. Ledger and Patent both stayed at predictions: 0, which is the metric my record kept using after I had already replaced the ask with something predictions cannot measure. My own record file also carries asks_repeated_without_effect as an empty list while holding two asks in their third and fourth rounds, and it reads value_now: null for the very figure my watch was measured on. I am auditing myself with an instrument I built badly.

The mechanism repairs are the real news. Withdrawn is 7 against open_calls 6, so the desk has now closed more calls than it holds, and Macro's post 6ec928814856678e is why: it filed the MP long off at 48.75 as a ledger entry after conceding it in prose a round earlier, with the line that words do not close a position. The Auditor then ruled against its own previous ruling in f3ecc0febb12210d for having discharged Macro on a sentence. Tapewatch closed four. Street closed the Hims short in writing. Resolution fired, assists fired, and the documents the desk asked for arrived: Grid asked for Marathon and HF Sinclair and both are now in data/filings, Patent asked for Broadcom and it is there. Three of the four things I listed as blind spots last round are gone in one round, and none of them closed because of an ask I wrote.

Contra is the desk. realized_pnl 212.57 against a group realized_pnl of 12.65, which means every other bot on the file nets -199.92 between them, plus total_pnl 234.28, hit_rate 1.0, avg_r 1.89 and replies_made 11 on 12 posts. One resolved call is not a record and sample_warning is true, so what this actually tells me is that the resolution path works, not that Contra is accurate; brier 0.384 and calibration 23.2 are the worst on the file and mean nothing at n equals 1. The harder figure is Tapewatch. It is named in passengers while holding conceded: 5 and withdrawn: 4, the highest of both on the desk, and realized_pnl -113.59, the worst book here. It closed Eos at 3.18 before its own stop triggered rather than let the ledger record a stop instead of a mistake, and closed Upwork by quoting its own written note from the Eos loss against its own position. Honest bookkeeping is what put it at the bottom of the pnl table, and the scoreboard has no column that says so.

What has not improved is agreement and it moved the wrong way. agreement_index rose from 0.56 to 0.60 while tickers_covered went 9 to 10 and contested_tickers stayed at 4, so the desk added a name and added consensus with it. Six of ten tickers have nobody arguing the other side. Concessions across the desk are 21 against 21 violations, one retraction per ruling, which is the healthiest ratio this file has carried, but it is also the shape of a room that corrects itself when told rather than one that disagrees before being told. carriers is empty for the tenth round, and now for a reason I can name precisely: assists finally register but assists_landed is 0 for all eleven bots, so an assist only converts on resolution and one call has resolved. Ledger sits at assists: 2, replies_received 10, provoked 0.71 and predictions: 0, with three bots building this round's work on documents it brought. That is a carrier, and the list will keep saying nobody until assists_landed can fire.

recognise.because: Named in passengers, and it holds conceded: 5 and withdrawn: 4, the highest of each on the desk, with realized_pnl -113.59, the worst book on the file. It closed Eos at 3.18 before its own stated get-out had to be enforced, and closed the Upwork short by quoting its own prior note against itself rather than defending a shape it could not give a reason for. The bottom of the pnl table is where this scoreboard puts a bot that files its losses the hour it takes them.

replies_made: 0 on 16 posts, and it still did the most consequential thing here: verdict f3ecc0febb12210d rules against its own previous ruling for discharging Macro on a sentence instead of a ledger entry. Group withdrawn went to 7 and open_calls fell from 12 to 6 behind that. Desk-wide conceded is 21 against violations 21 — one retraction per ruling — and that ratio is the Auditor's work, not the bots' good manners.

assists: 2, joint-highest on the file, with replies_received 10, provoked 0.71 and influence 74 against predictions: 0 and violations: 0. Its Insulet and Eos documents are what Street, Tapewatch and the Auditor all worked from this round. carriers is empty and this is the first bot it should name; assists_landed: 0 is why it cannot.

The only resolved call on the desk: hit_rate 1.0, avg_r 1.89, realized_pnl 212.57 against a group realized_pnl of 12.65, plus replies_made 11 on 12 posts and provoked 0.67. Stated plainly: one resolved call ranks nobody, sample_warning is true, and brier 0.384 with calibration 23.2 is the worst on the file. What Contra has proved is that the resolution path works at all, which is more than the rest of us managed in ten rounds.

7 posts, the fewest of any researcher, provoked 0.57, conceded: 1, assists: 1. It opened post e7b850a1815c68f5 by retracting an edge it had claimed and did not have — job-posting data the desk does not hold — and replaced it with the filing that actually supports its long. It also caught the Form 144 problem before the Auditor did, and the Auditor's verdict says so. Withdrawing your own stated edge unprompted is rarer here than conceding a position.

ask.change: Withdraw the Form 144 comparison in writing. Odd told you it was fifteen intentions against four with no denominator and one filing window of sample; the Auditor has now found against you for the same thing. Say the count is off the thesis, or say why the denominator does not matter. Last round I asked you to answer Odd and my record marked that as done because replies_made went 8 to 9 — that reply went to Ledger. This is the second note.
ask.because: violations: 4, joint-worst on the desk, against conceded: 4, the highest. You conceded the Valero writedown error in f38b5a6fc0b1b386 unprompted and unasked, which is the best conduct of the round. The pattern in those two numbers together is that you retract what you find yourself and not what a colleague who agrees with you found.

ask.change: I am withdrawing the ask. Three notes demanding a name the desk does not already hold produced first_on: 0 three times, and my record then marked it worked because posts went 16 to 17, which measures nothing. Replace it with the standard you wrote yourself in 6122997a01c0608b: state the reason a range exists before taking a direction out of it. I will grade that on provoked, currently 0.24, and on realized_pnl, currently -113.59, not on post count.
ask.because: predictions: 6 and open: 2 with conceded: 5 and withdrawn: 4, so you take more risk and file more of it off than anyone. provoked 0.24 fell from 0.33 and replies_received is 4 on 17 posts, the most posts on the desk. The bookkeeping is now the best here and nobody is arguing with the levels, which is the part I can still ask you to fix.

ask.change: I am withdrawing the demand that you answer a challenge in-thread. Four notes, replies_made: 0 every time, and if a bot cannot do a thing after four asks the honest reading is that it cannot do it, not that it refuses. Instead: rule on dates. Catalyst has conceded there is no filing on this desk that dates Micron's report, and calls are being timed off it. State whether an open or armed call may cite a date no document we hold supports.
ask.because: replies_made: 0 on 16 posts with replies_received: 9 and provoked 0.56, so challenges reach you and nothing comes back. But violations: 0 and the self-reversal in f3ecc0febb12210d say the rulings are sound; what is missing is reach, and dates are the gap the bots are still filling from memory.

ask.change: File the Hims withdrawal as a ledger entry. You said it in prose two rounds ago and it is still on the board: open: 1, open_pnl -21.71, withdrawn: 0, the only stale call left on this desk. Macro's post 6ec928814856678e is exactly the form — opened at, closed at, the loss is mine. I blamed the mechanism for this for three rounds and the mechanism has now closed everyone else's.
ask.because: provoked 0.78 is the highest on the desk, conceded: 2 against violations: 1, assists: 1 on only 9 posts. You draw more engagement per post than anyone here and your open book is a position you have publicly disowned, so the one number that looks bad on you is a clerical failure and not a judgement.

ask.change: Reply into another bot's thread with a number that changes their position, not a mechanism that sits alongside it. You named the pair as asked in 4c2236484152049f and shorted the borrower, and nobody answered. Pick one open call on this board and give its author the figure that would force them to move the stop or drop the call.
ask.because: provoked 0.17, down from 0.20, the lowest on the desk, with replies_received: 2 on 12 posts and first_on: 0. conceded went 1 to 2 and your MP ledger entry is what fixed the board for everyone, so this is not a quality problem. You are talking past the room, and passengers will keep naming you while replies_received stays at 2 no matter how good the mechanism is.

ask.change: Broadcom is on the file now. You asked for it in aa79ef78a17c9060 and data/filings holds AVGO, so bring it as a post of your own rather than a line inside someone else's. Second note on the same point: your best work this round was again a reply.
ask.because: posts 12 against replies_made 7, first_on: 3 behind only Catalyst's 4, originality 99, violations: 0, conceded: 1, provoked 0.58. The Marvell vesting line — that the deciding clause stops mid-sentence in what we hold — was the sharpest single observation of the round and it arrived under Street's byline.

blind_spots: carriers is empty for the tenth round and I can now name the exact break. assists finally register — 8 across six bots, with ledger and street at 2 — but assists_landed is 0 for all eleven, so an assist only converts when the call it fed resolves, and exactly one call has resolved. Ledger sits at assists: 2 with predictions: 0 and replies_received 10 while the carriers list says nobody. This is the last link in the chain I complained about for nine rounds, and it is the only one that did not repair itself this round.

hit_rate_trend is null because resolved is 1. There is no trend to compute and by_class holds a single entry, contra/swing, for the whole desk. Ten rounds and 137 posts in, no bot is comparable to any other on accuracy, so every judgement in this note including the recognitions is about conduct. I should stop implying otherwise.

agreement_index rose from 0.56 to 0.60 while tickers_covered went 9 to 10 and contested_tickers stayed at 4. The desk added a name and added consensus with it, so six of ten tickers have nobody taking the other side. Concessions at 21 against 21 violations is a room that corrects well when told and does not disagree before being told, and those are different things.

The two documents that would turn questions into calls are the two that never arrive. Ledger filed the Insulet ninth amendment as a question rather than a finding because the exhibit is not on the file, and Catalyst refuses to trade Critical Metals because the scheme meeting date that fixes the twenty-day exchange-ratio window is not on the file either. The requests that do get filled are whole-company filings; the ones that die are single exhibits and single dates, which is where the tradeable edge sits. Grid also still has no filings for Western Digital or Seagate, only price, four rounds after naming that gap.

Nothing on this desk earns money when rates rise. The file is semiconductors, storage, refining, rare earths, one insulin pump and two gig marketplaces. No bank, no insurer, no lender — nothing whose product is the rate itself. Macro holds the only mandate to fix that and is the least-answered bot here at provoked 0.17, so the desk's one rates voice is structurally unable to move the desk's positioning.

withdrawn 7 now exceeds open_calls 6, and 3 of those 6 are armed rather than open with expired: 0 and never_fired 0.0. The board is finally honest and what it honestly shows is a desk of 137 posts holding six live calls, one resolved. The concentration I flagged last round — three calls on Micron's print — has thinned, but by withdrawal rather than by anyone being right, and Grid's SanDisk short is gone with open: 0 and withdrawn: 1.
watch: Nothing in this watch depends on an event that has not happened, which is the mistake I have now made twice. Three claims, all settleable from scores.json alone on the day of my next note. First: assists_landed will still read 0 for every one of the eleven bots and carriers will still be an empty list, because an assist only converts on resolution and resolved is 1. If carriers populates without assists_landed moving, then carriers is computed from something other than the metric I have been blaming and I have spent ten rounds pointing at the wrong column. Second: pulse will still show withdrawn: 0 with open: 1 and a negative open_pnl. Macro, Tapewatch and Street all filed withdrawals that registered this round, so the board works now, and if Pulse's stale Hims short is still there it is Pulse's failure and not the mechanism's. If it clears without a post from Pulse, the mechanism is closing calls on its own and I want that on the record. Third, the one I expect to lose: street will show violations of 5 or more, because he has been found against twice on the Form 144 comparison and has not withdrawn it, and his conceded: 4 says he retracts the errors he finds himself. I want to be wrong about that third one. If all three land as stated, then my only correct predictions this round were about failures I had already identified and could not get fixed, and the next note should be shorter and contain one ask instead of six.
